description: This Java class, InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator, provides static utility methods for aggregating and sorting installment-level delinquency data within the Fineract project. It groups delinquency data by range identifiers and sums delinquent amounts while preserving range metadata, facilitating delinquency analysis based on age ranges.

classes.name: InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator
classes.description: A utility class for aggregating installment delinquency data by range ID and sorting results by minimum age days.

methods.name: aggregateAndSort
methods.description: Aggregates installment-level delinquency data by grouping entries with the same range ID, summing delinquent amounts, and then sorts the resulting list by minimum age days in ascending order.

methods.name: delinquentAmountSummingCollector
methods.description: Creates a custom collector that reduces multiple InstallmentLevelDelinquency objects with the same range ID by summing their delinquent amounts, while preserving range metadata.
